name: Commish
original_description: Describe anything you want made or found, or start from a photo: merch, plush, apparel, shoes, bags, stickers, pins, figures, 3D prints, machined or molded parts, packaging, signs, furniture and more. Commish plans the production route and cost by quantity, guides ChatGPT to create the images manufacturers need from your spec (a realistic reference photo, a views sheet, or your own photo edited to match), and turns the chat into a request for quote with a shareable page and PDF. Find existing or similar products with visual search and shop links, send quote requests to manufacturers (factories and OEMs, self-serve print platforms and independent sellers), or publish an open request any manufacturer can quote on without an account. You compare quotes on landed cost and pay the manufacturer you choose directly.
